nycpluto: NYC Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)

Source: R/nycpluto-package.R
nycpluto-package.Rd

The New York City Department of City Planning Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO) and MapPLUTO: one record per tax lot with land use, building, zoning, ownership, and assessed value fields, plus lot polygons. Data are stored as a GeoParquet file and accessed via duckplyr. Also includes the PLUTO change file and land use and building class lookup tables.
